## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (lint, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] New or changed logic in `domain/` or `data/` has unit tests
- [ ] Tap targets are at least 56px, and the change works one-handed
- [ ] Inputs have real labels; icon-only buttons have screen-reader text
- [ ] No new network calls, telemetry, or analytics
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or the PR explains why it is worth it)
- [ ] Nothing here diagnoses anything or gives medical advice
